lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: What is the most effective defensive action when confronting an enraged, aggressive driver?

options.text: Tap your vehicle brakes suddenly to warn them they are following too close
Roll down your window and explain Texas right-of-way statutes with gestures
Match their highway speed and block them from changing lanes to show control
Avoid eye contact, remain calm, do not gesture, and allow them plenty of room to pass
